Team — attaching the consolidated investor/board deck (v1.0) and a short OKR scorecard export. This is the first full pass; two immediate asks: 

1) Red/amber/green on the deck by EOD Mon (9/21). Mark exact slide numbers and one-line rationale. We need to triage content vs. ask.
2) Pull any hard metrics that require pre-approval (forecast changes, ARR re-forecast, attrition commentary) into a separate appendix and flag them to Finance/People.

Notes:
- I consolidated product and go-to-market updates into a single "Progress & Risks" section to keep the deck under 20 slides.
- There is a short risk heatmap (last slide) that I flagged as "require board remediation" for two items: Dedicated capacity SLA delta and Private deployment compliance timeline.

Attachments:
- 2026-09-19-board-update-deck-v1.0.pptx (outline + speaker notes)
- QBR-OKR-scorecard.csv (raw export)

Proposed schedule: internal dry-run Wed 9/23 10:30–11:30 PT, full readout with Board Secretariat Fri 9/24 09:00 PT. Please confirm availability and slot conflicts.

1) Financial ask language: we should avoid explicit forward guidance beyond the range we already committed; replace any phrasing that looks like a FY forecast with "range" language and reference Finance-approved note (see comment on slide 4).
2) SLA/Compliance mitigation: add a 2-slide plan that shows the temporary fallback/contingency we will offer customers if Private timeline slips. Board will want to see remediation and customer impact.

I'll add suggested bullets in the Drive link and leave comments inline.
